screen.datura_origins.confirm.title: CONFIRM ORIGIN
screen.datura_origins.confirm.body: You will awaken as %s. Once confirmed, this choice cannot be changed from this screen.
datura_origins.command.none: You haven't chosen a race yet.
datura_origins.command.no_maturity: Your race has no maturity system.
datura_origins.command.no_cooldown_on: No-cooldown mode ON (use again to turn it off).
datura_origins.message.locked: You are bound and cannot act!
datura_origins.message.maturity_grow: ✦ Your body grows. Your strength matures.
datura_origins.message.bat_no_room: No room to return to your normal form.
datura_origins.message.bat_hungry: Too weak to become a bat: you need blood.
datura_origins.message.bite_in_bat: Return to your normal form to bite.
datura_origins.message.meat_only: That isn't meat. Your stomach refuses it.
datura_origins.message.blood_only: Your body rejects that. You need blood.
datura_origins.message.no_armor: Your body doesn't fit in this armor.
datura_origins.message.no_surface: No solid ground in sight to go to.
datura_origins.message.elf_food: That is too repulsive for an elf.
datura_origins.message.vegetarian: You don't eat meat or fish.
datura_origins.message.dryad_betrayal: The forest judged you for betrayal.
datura_origins.message.fungal_emergency: A giant mushroom bursts out and lifts you away from danger!
datura_origins.message.need_ground: You need to stand on solid ground.
datura_origins.message.nether_weak: The Nether smothers your nature: your powers sleep here.
datura_origins.message.nether_restored: Away from the Nether, your powers awaken again.
datura_origins.message.mermaid_armor: Your tail doesn't fit in that.
datura_origins.message.altar_empty: Hold the item you want to enchant.
datura_origins.message.altar_none: This item can't receive more enchantments.
datura_origins.message.altar_lost: The item left your hand: the enchantment was lost.
screen.datura_origins.altar.hint: Click to enchant the item in your hand
datura_origins.message.sleep_high: You can only sleep up high (above Y %s).
datura_origins.message.no_helmet: Your horns don't let you wear a helmet.
datura_origins.message.no_enchanted: The glow of the enchantment burns your hands.
datura_origins.message.undead_grow: ✦ The dead answer your call with more strength.
datura_origins.message.stone_diet: Stone doesn't eat. Stay still to regain your strength.
datura_origins.message.noble_tools: A cheap tool? Only gold, diamond or netherite will do for you.
datura_origins.message.casino_empty: Hold the item you want to bet.
datura_origins.message.casino_lose: The house always wins... the item is gone.
datura_origins.message.casino_even: Nothing this time: the item comes back to you.
race.datura_origins.elfo.name: Elf
race.datura_origins.elfo.description: Light, alert and patient. Crosses forests without a sound and lands arrows where others can barely see the target, but has a fragile body.
race.datura_origins.elfo.advantage.0: 10% faster and falls 3 extra blocks without getting hurt.
race.datura_origins.elfo.advantage.1: Arrows and other projectiles deal 50% more damage.
race.datura_origins.elfo.advantage.2: Hunger drains at half the rate.
race.datura_origins.elfo.disadvantage.2: Refuses rotten flesh, spider eyes and poisonous potatoes.
race.datura_origins.elfo.disadvantage.3: Deals 1.5 less melee damage in the Nether.
race.datura_origins.elfo.ability.name: Agile Retreat
race.datura_origins.elfo.ability.descrip: Leaps backward and, mid-jump, fires an energy sphere forward that explodes on hit, dealing 6 damage and knocking the target back. Cooldown: 7.5 seconds.
race.datura_origins.elfo_real.name: High Elf
race.datura_origins.elfo_real.descriptio: An elf of the royal bloodline, raised among gold, honor and ancient magic. A little taller than a human, protected by a golden aegis.
12% faster and falls 3 extra blocks without getting hurt.
Arrows and other projectiles deal 50% more damage.

Golden Aegis: every 60 seconds gains a golden outline that cancels the next attack. If it is melee, the attacker and anyone nearby are thrown back. If it is a projectile or a cast ability, he teleports away before the impact (and falls slowly if he appears in the air).
race.datura_origins.elfo_real.disadvanta: Has only 9 hearts and deals 1 less melee damage.
When a fall hurts, it hurts 50% more.
Refuses rotten flesh, spider eyes and poisonous potatoes.
race.datura_origins.elfo_real.ability.de: Opens a golden runic circle in front of him for 3 seconds. Every enemy hit during that time is cancelled and returned to the attacker. While the shield is open, he walks slowly and cannot attack. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
race.datura_origins.elfo_noturno.name: Night Elf
race.datura_origins.elfo_noturno.descrip: An elf who traded the sun for the shadows. A silent assassin who hunts when the moon rises and vanishes into the dark in the blink of an eye.
race.datura_origins.elfo_noturno.advanta: At night deals 2 more damage and is 15% faster.
Falls 3 extra blocks without getting hurt.
His hits inflict Wither for 3 seconds.
race.datura_origins.elfo_noturno.disadva: Deals 1.5 less damage during the day.
race.datura_origins.elfo_noturno.ability: Melts into shadow and reappears on any solid ground he is looking at, up to 32 blocks away, staying invisible for 3 seconds. Never passes through walls. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
race.datura_origins.elfo_lua.name: Moon Elf
race.datura_origins.elfo_lua.description: A graceful elf who dances in the moonlight. A little taller than a human, delicate by day and dangerous when the moon rises.
race.datura_origins.elfo_lua.advantage.0: At night deals 3 more damage, is 15% faster and gains +4 armor.
race.datura_origins.elfo_lua.advantage.1: Permanent night vision and silent steps.
race.datura_origins.elfo_lua.advantage.3: The Warden does not attack him.
race.datura_origins.elfo_lua.advantage.4: His hits inflict Wither for 3 seconds.
race.datura_origins.elfo_lua.advantage.5: Eclipse Mark: at night, every 3 hits on the same target a lunar flash explodes on it, dealing 5 damage and blinding it.
race.datura_origins.elfo_lua.advantage.6: At night has more luck with fishing and chests.
race.datura_origins.elfo_lua.disadvantag: Deals 2 less damage during the day.
race.datura_origins.elfo_lua.ability.des: Raises his arms and summons a huge moon: everyone nearby is blinded and slowed a lot, and he cannot attack during the summoning. Then the moon falls on the aimed target, opening a crater and dealing massive damage. Cooldown: 4 minutes.
race.datura_origins.vampiro.name: Vampire
race.datura_origins.vampiro.description: A creature of the night that lives on blood. Stronger and faster than a human, but the sun destroys it.
race.datura_origins.vampiro.advantage.0: Stronger and faster than a human: +2 damage, +15% speed and 2 extra hearts.
race.datura_origins.vampiro.advantage.2: Bat form: jump in mid-air to turn into a bat and fly freely. When landing or turning flight off, returns to normal and must wait 30 seconds to transform again.
race.datura_origins.vampiro.disadvantage: Only feeds on blood, using the Vampire Bite. Regular food does nothing.
Hunger drains faster, and much faster in bat form.
The sun burns: during the day, under open sky, he catches fire and dies quickly. Fire also deals 50% more damage.
With empty hunger he loses all bonuses and powers. Only the bite keeps working.
race.datura_origins.vampiro.ability.name: Vampire Bite
race.datura_origins.vampiro.ability.desc: Grabs the creature in front and drinks its blood for 1.5 seconds, restoring health and hunger. Monster blood is poisonous. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
race.datura_origins.dragao.name: Dragon
race.datura_origins.dragao.description: A dragon in a human body. Grows larger, stronger and tougher as it slays monsters.
race.datura_origins.dragao.advantage.0: Natural plating equal to a full set of iron armor. It hardens and the body gains more hearts at each maturity stage.
race.datura_origins.dragao.advantage.1: Stronger than a human: melee damage increases at each stage.
race.datura_origins.dragao.advantage.2: Immune to fire and lava, and heals inside flames. Fire doesn't stick to its body.
race.datura_origins.dragao.advantage.4: Grows by killing monsters: each maturity stage makes the body bigger and stronger.
Cannot wear armor: it is too small for it.
Huge: is born about 3 blocks tall and reaches 4 at its peak, so it cannot pass through regular doors and tunnels.
Needs room: with fewer than 6 free blocks above, it becomes slow, trembles and gets hungrier.
Gains no experience: the bar shows maturity instead.
race.datura_origins.dragao.ability.name: Fireball
race.datura_origins.dragao.ability.descr: Shoots a fireball that explodes with the force of TNT, setting nearby creatures and the ground on fire. Damage grows with maturity. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
race.datura_origins.raposa_mistica.name: Mystic Fox
race.datura_origins.raposa_mistica.descr: An enchanted fox with ember-colored fur who lives among people but prefers the company of foxes. Her illusions burn whatever they touch.
race.datura_origins.raposa_mistica.advan: Fire Form: immune to fire, and every hit sets the enemy ablaze.
Fire Form: walks through sweet berry bushes without getting hurt.
Silent steps. After standing still for 3 seconds she becomes fully camouflaged and no monster notices her.
Foxes trust her and follow her for a while.
race.datura_origins.raposa_mistica.disad: No effect works on her, good or bad (not even golden apples).
race.datura_origins.raposa_mistica.abili: Creates three illusions of herself that fight by her side for 10 seconds and burn the enemies they hit. Cooldown: 67 seconds.
An enchanted fox with ice-white fur who lives among people but prefers the company of foxes. Her illusions freeze whatever they touch.
Snow Form: immune to freezing, and every hit freezes and slows the enemy.
Snow Form: walks on powder snow without sinking.
Silent steps. After standing still for 3 seconds she becomes fully camouflaged and no monster notices her.
Foxes trust her and follow her for a while.
No effect works on her, good or bad (not even golden apples).
Creates three illusions of herself that fight by her side for 10 seconds and freeze the enemies they hit. Cooldown: 67 seconds.
race.datura_origins.dama_cogumelo.name: Mushroom Lady
race.datura_origins.dama_cogumelo.descri: A dryad who grew up in the damp shade of the forests, where light barely reaches. Instead of flowers, she carries an amanita cap and a cauldron of poisonous spores. When she is close to death, a giant mushroom bursts from the ground and lifts her away from danger.
race.datura_origins.dama_cogumelo.advant: Half a block taller than a human, with 2 extra hearts and 2 natural armor.
Suffers nothing inside her own spores: gains a 2-heart shield and heals.
Creature of the shade: deals 2 more damage at night.
race.datura_origins.dama_cogumelo.disadv: The sun dries her out: deals 1 less damage during the day.
race.datura_origins.dama_cogumelo.passiv: Emergency Mushroom: when she drops to 4 hearts, she releases a spore burst that hurts and pushes enemies, a giant mushroom grows from the ground and carries her to the top, regenerating health for 10 s. The mushroom disappears after 30 s. Cooldown: 5 minutes.
race.datura_origins.dama_cogumelo.abilit: Throws a cauldron in an arc. Where it lands, it stays on the ground for 10 s releasing a spore cloud up to 8 blocks wide: anyone inside is poisoned, weakened, dizzy and glows through walls, losing half a heart per second. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
race.datura_origins.driade.name: Dryad
race.datura_origins.driade.description: A nymph of nature, born from sap and dew. Plants grow where she steps and animals treat her as part of the forest. But fire consumes her, the Nether burns her alive and the forest itself punishes the dryad who fells a tree.
race.datura_origins.driade.advantage.0: Half a block taller than a human, with 2 extra hearts and 4 natural armor.
race.datura_origins.driade.advantage.1: Photosynthesis: regenerates health under the sun and her hunger refills on its own.
race.datura_origins.driade.advantage.2: Nearby crops and plants grow on their own, much faster when she stands still near them.
race.datura_origins.driade.advantage.4: Immune to poison, Wither and berry bush thorns.
race.datura_origins.driade.advantage.5: Firm roots: takes half the knockback.
race.datura_origins.driade.advantage.6: Animals don't attack her and don't flee from her.
Breaking a tree log is betrayal: the forest kills her instantly.
Fire deals double damage, and she catches fire in the Nether.
Loses all advantages and her ability in the Nether (everything returns when she leaves).
race.datura_origins.driade.passive.0: When she dies, flowers bloom on the ground around her.
race.datura_origins.driade.ability.name: Bloom
race.datura_origins.driade.ability.descr: Releases a wave of energy in a 20-block radius: saplings become trees, crops ripen and plants grow instantly. The wave also pushes away creatures within 8 blocks of her. Cooldown: 5 minutes.
race.datura_origins.espectro.name: Specter
race.datura_origins.espectro.description: The soul that refused to leave: the figure at the end of the hallway, the cold that passes through the wall. Feels no hunger, sees in the dark and monsters let it pass as one of their own. But water undoes it, the Nether claims what is its own and everything that heals the living burns what is left of it.
race.datura_origins.espectro.advantage.0: Already dead: feels no hunger and doesn't need to eat.
race.datura_origins.espectro.advantage.3: Monsters don't attack it unless it attacks first.
race.datura_origins.espectro.advantage.4: Light as mist: takes no fall damage.
race.datura_origins.espectro.disadvantag: Rain and water deal 2 hearts of damage per second.
In the Nether it dissolves as if in rain and loses all advantages and its ability (everything returns when it leaves).
Healing potions and good effects hurt it; bad effects make it stronger.
Deals 1 less damage during the day.
race.datura_origins.espectro.ability.des: Becomes invisible and passes through walls, like a spectator, with no time limit. Press again to return to its body, as long as there is room. Cooldown: 5 seconds.
race.datura_origins.minotauro.name: Minotaur
race.datura_origins.minotauro.descriptio: A bull-headed giant raised in stone labyrinths. Slow and heavy, but every blow brings down walls. Hates being cornered, and when it truly bleeds, fury takes over: snorting smoke, it grows even stronger.
3 blocks tall, with 3 extra hearts, 3 more damage and 6 natural armor.
Breaks blocks 60% faster and steps up higher ledges.
Firm stance: almost impossible to push.
race.datura_origins.minotauro.disadvanta: Too big for regular doors and tunnels.
Becomes slow and tired in cramped places.
Vegetarian, and each food fills 40% less.
race.datura_origins.minotauro.passive.0: Bull's Fury: at 4 hearts or less it goes berserk, with strong Strength and Regeneration, snorting smoke. It ends when it is back at 6 hearts.
race.datura_origins.minotauro.ability.de: Rips a large block of stone from the ground, lifts it overhead and throws it where it aims: deals 10 damage, explodes on impact and scatters shards. Must be on the ground. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
race.datura_origins.fada.name: Fairy
race.datura_origins.fada.description: Small, bright and mischievous, born from forest dew. Flies endlessly on moth wings, makes plants grow and prefers to help in a fight: she opens a field of flowers that heals her friends and keeps monsters away. Alone she is fragile, but a group with a fairy nearby rarely falls.
race.datura_origins.fada.advantage.0: Flies without limit, as fast as an elytra with rockets: in the air, press jump again to take off. Hold sneak to glide without boosting.
race.datura_origins.fada.advantage.1: Too small to be noticed: monsters don't attack her until she attacks one of them (the truce returns 30 seconds later).
race.datura_origins.fada.advantage.2: Eats like a bird: each food fills double and hunger drains at half the rate.
race.datura_origins.fada.advantage.3: Slowly regenerates health and makes nearby plants grow.
race.datura_origins.fada.advantage.4: Lily pad: when landing on water, a lily pad appears under her feet and keeps her afloat (sneak to dive).
race.datura_origins.fada.advantage.5: Takes no fall damage, sees in the dark, is lucky, walks 15% faster and reaches blocks 1.5 blocks farther.
race.datura_origins.fada.disadvantage.0: Only one block tall with 6 hearts, and her hits deal 1 less damage.
race.datura_origins.fada.disadvantage.3: Flying is tiring: hunger drains while she is in the air.
race.datura_origins.fada.ability.name: Flower Sanctuary
race.datura_origins.fada.ability.descrip: Opens a 10-block circle of flowers on the ground for 20 seconds. No monster can enter, and everyone inside (players and tamed animals) recovers 1 heart per second. Cooldown: 52 seconds.
race.datura_origins.sereia.name: Mermaid
race.datura_origins.sereia.description: A daughter of the sea, with shining scales and a voice that calms storms. Gentle with those who respect the ocean, she protects her friends with her own song. In water she is almost unbeatable, but on land she depends on others to go far.
race.datura_origins.sereia.advantage.0: Breathes underwater, swims like a dolphin (Dolphin's Grace and Conduit Power) and sees clearly in the deep sea.
race.datura_origins.sereia.advantage.1: Also breathes normally out of water.
race.datura_origins.sereia.advantage.2: In water deals 7 more damage, gains 8 armor and 5 extra hearts, attacks 30% faster and regenerates half a heart per second.
Cannot walk out of water: only crawls slowly. After standing still for 3 seconds, sits on her own tail.
Dry scales: after 60 seconds away from water and rain, becomes slow and weak until wet again.
Out of water has only 9 hearts.
The tail does not allow leggings or boots.
race.datura_origins.sereia.ability.name: Tidal Song
race.datura_origins.sereia.ability.descr: Sings for 12 seconds. Monsters within 16 blocks forget their target, become slow and weak and are slowly pulled toward her. Nearby allies recover 1.5 hearts per second and gain Water Breathing. Cooldown: 45 seconds.
race.datura_origins.sereia_cristal.name: Deep Sea Mermaid
race.datura_origins.sereia_cristal.descr: She lives at the dark bottom of the ocean, where her larger tail became covered in crystals that glow on their own. She keeps the ancient secrets of the sea and knows how to awaken the magic hidden in weapons and armor.
race.datura_origins.sereia_cristal.advan: Breathes underwater, swims like a dolphin (Dolphin's Grace and Conduit Power) and sees clearly in the deep sea.
Also breathes normally out of water.
In water deals 7 more damage, gains 8 armor and 5 extra hearts, attacks 30% faster and regenerates half a heart per second.
race.datura_origins.sereia_cristal.disad: Cannot walk out of water: only crawls slowly. After standing still for 3 seconds, sits on her own tail.
Dry scales: after 60 seconds away from water and rain, becomes slow and weak until wet again.
Out of water has only 9 hearts.
The tail does not allow leggings or boots.
race.datura_origins.sereia_cristal.abili: Opens an enchanting table only she can see, with three random enchantments at random levels for the item in her hand. Choosing one costs nothing. Cooldown: 3 minutes.
race.datura_origins.sereia_grega.name: Greek Siren
race.datura_origins.sereia_grega.descrip: The siren of Greek myths: she sings to lure sailors and drags them to the depths. The same strength as the enchanted mermaid, but hungry for meat and nothing else.
race.datura_origins.sereia_grega.advanta: Breathes underwater, swims like a dolphin (Dolphin's Grace and Conduit Power) and sees clearly in the deep sea.
Also breathes normally out of water.
In water deals 7 more damage, gains 8 armor and 5 extra hearts, attacks 30% faster and regenerates half a heart per second.
race.datura_origins.sereia_grega.disadva: Cannot walk out of water: only crawls slowly. After standing still for 3 seconds, sits on her own tail.
Dry scales: after 60 seconds away from water and rain, becomes slow and weak until wet again.
Out of water has only 9 hearts.
The tail does not allow leggings or boots.
race.datura_origins.sereia_grega.ability: Sings for 12 seconds. Monsters within 16 blocks forget their target, become slow and weak and are slowly pulled toward her. Nearby allies recover 1.5 hearts per second and gain Water Breathing. Cooldown: 45 seconds.
race.datura_origins.orc.name: Orc
race.datura_origins.orc.description: A warrior of the horde, with green skin and a fierce gaze, raised among scars and war fires. Neither subtle nor clever, but hits like no one else and can take a beating. When he stomps hard, the whole ground answers.
race.datura_origins.orc.advantage.1: Thick hide: 3 natural armor and takes 30% less knockback.
race.datura_origins.orc.advantage.2: Iron stomach: immune to poison and hunger.
race.datura_origins.orc.advantage.3: A little bigger than a human.
race.datura_origins.orc.advantage.4: Butcher: animals he kills drop double meat and leather.
race.datura_origins.orc.disadvantage.1: Frowned upon: villagers charge him more.
race.datura_origins.orc.ability.name: Stomp
race.datura_origins.orc.ability.descript: Raises his foot and slams it down with all his weight: the shockwave throws everything within 4 blocks into the air and deals up to 7 damage. Cooldown: 18 seconds.
race.datura_origins.bode.name: Goat
race.datura_origins.bode.description: A mountain satyr who inherited everything from the goat: sure hooves, thick wool and curved horns. Lives on the snowy peaks, where no fall scares him and no cold reaches him. Stubborn and tireless, he only rests up high, close to the sky.
race.datura_origins.bode.advantage.0: 4 natural armor, with the same strength and health as a human.
race.datura_origins.bode.advantage.2: Walks 10% faster and hunger drains more slowly.
race.datura_origins.bode.advantage.3: His hooves walk on powder snow and magma blocks without getting hurt.
race.datura_origins.bode.advantage.4: Wool protects from cold and heat: immune to freezing, and fire hurts 40% less.
race.datura_origins.bode.advantage.5: Child of the heights: above Y 100 deals 2 more damage.
race.datura_origins.bode.disadvantage.1: Only eats plants, and each food fills 40% less.
race.datura_origins.bode.disadvantage.2: Can only sleep up high (above Y 100).
race.datura_origins.bode.passive.0: Mountain Leap: every jump goes up to 5 blocks high, no charging needed.
race.datura_origins.bode.ability.name: Headbutt
race.datura_origins.bode.ability.descrip: Charges head first and launches the first target in front far away, dealing 2 damage. Cooldown: 10.5 seconds.
race.datura_origins.morto_vivo.name: Undead
race.datura_origins.morto_vivo.descripti: Died, but would not accept it. The soul crawled back into its own body and now only wants to settle the score. Doesn't eat, doesn't rest, and the world's dead recognize it as one of their own. Every monster it brings down strengthens the small army it raises from the ground.
race.datura_origins.morto_vivo.advantage: Zombies, skeletons and other undead ignore it unless it attacks.
Tough corpse body: 2 extra hearts, 2 natural armor and 1 more damage.
Lifeless body: immune to poison and hunger.
Killing monsters strengthens its zombies, across 4 levels (instead of experience).
race.datura_origins.morto_vivo.disadvant: Healing potions and powers hurt it; bad effects make it stronger.
Loses all advantages and its ability in the Nether (everything returns when it leaves, without losing progress).
race.datura_origins.morto_vivo.ability.d: Raises 3 zombies that attack whoever you attack (or whoever attacks you) for 30 seconds. They start with chainmail; with more levels they get better swords and armor, up to enchanted iron. Cooldown: 1 minute.
race.datura_origins.demonio.name: Demon
race.datura_origins.demonio.description: A creature of darkness that lives by deceiving and bargaining with humans. Smiles at the deal and collects later. Monsters recognize it and step aside, and the Nether welcomes it like home. Every soul it reaps makes it stronger, but the glow of an enchantment hurts it like nothing else.
race.datura_origins.demonio.advantage.0: Stronger and 10% faster than a human: 2 more damage, 2 extra hearts, 4 natural armor and takes 40% less knockback.
race.datura_origins.demonio.advantage.1: In the Nether deals 2 more damage and gains 3 more armor.
race.datura_origins.demonio.advantage.2: Infernal charm: villagers give it discounts.
race.datura_origins.demonio.advantage.3: Monsters don't attack it unless it attacks first.
race.datura_origins.demonio.advantage.4: The closer to death, the faster it regenerates.
race.datura_origins.demonio.advantage.5: Immune to fire, sees in the dark and its hits set enemies on fire.
race.datura_origins.demonio.advantage.6: Curses (Binding and Vanishing) don't affect it.
race.datura_origins.demonio.disadvantage: Enchanted weapons deal 75% more damage to it, and it cannot use or wear anything enchanted.
Carrying any enchanted item in the inventory hurts it.
Poison, hunger and Wither hurt it 50% more.
race.datura_origins.demonio.passive.0: Soul harvest: whoever it kills drops red souls (more souls the stronger the victim). Absorbing them, it matures through 5 phases, each with more damage, health and armor. In its final form, Infernal Thorns return 30% of the damage taken to the attacker. Regular experience remains separate.
race.datura_origins.gargula.name: Gargoyle
race.datura_origins.gargula.description: A statue awakened by magic. Its flesh is stone, its blood is enchantment and, even made of stone, it truly flies on its own wings. It doesn't eat or drink: when it needs strength, it stays still and becomes a statue again until its body mends.
race.datura_origins.gargula.advantage.0: Same health as a human, but with 8 natural armor, 3 toughness and 2 more damage.
race.datura_origins.gargula.advantage.1: Flies on its own wings, as fast as an elytra with rockets: in the air, press jump again to take off. Hold sneak to glide without boosting.
race.datura_origins.gargula.advantage.2: Standing still on the ground for 5 seconds, it turns into a statue and recovers health and hunger.
race.datura_origins.gargula.advantage.3: Immune to knockback and fire, and doesn't drown.
race.datura_origins.gargula.advantage.4: Stone Skin: hits of more than 5 hearts lose 3 hearts of damage.
race.datura_origins.gargula.advantage.5: Night guardian: deals 2 more damage at night.
race.datura_origins.gargula.advantage.6: Stone eyes: sees in the dark.
race.datura_origins.gargula.disadvantage: Cannot eat anything (in exchange, hunger drains very slowly).
Sinks in water and cannot swim.
Under the sun the stone grows heavy: walks 10% slower during the day.
race.datura_origins.gargula.ability.name: Meteor
race.datura_origins.gargula.ability.desc: Leaps very high, turns to stone and plummets: the impact deals up to 16 damage in a 4.5-block radius and throws enemies far away. Takes no fall damage. Cooldown: 37.5 seconds.
race.datura_origins.lilac.name: Lilac
race.datura_origins.lilac.description: A genie of the lamp who only grants her own wishes. Surrounded by gold and addicted to gambling, she smells ore from afar and turns anything into a bet.
race.datura_origins.lilac.advantage.0: Stronger and tougher than a human: 2 more damage, 2 extra hearts and 2 armor.
race.datura_origins.lilac.advantage.1: Natural fortune: ores she breaks drop as if the tool had Fortune II, even without enchantments.
race.datura_origins.lilac.advantage.2: Gains 30% more experience and is lucky.
race.datura_origins.lilac.advantage.3: Midas touch: defeated monsters sometimes drop gold nuggets.
race.datura_origins.lilac.disadvantage.0: Only uses gold, diamond or netherite tools and weapons.
race.datura_origins.lilac.disadvantage.1: Without gold in her inventory, deals 2 less damage and walks 10% slower.
race.datura_origins.lilac.ability.name: Casino
race.datura_origins.lilac.ability.descri: Bets the item in her hand on a roulette only she can see: she can lose it all, break even or multiply it by 2, 3, 4 or even 5. The rarer the item, the harder it is to win. Cooldown: 5 minutes.
race.datura_origins.kitsune.name: Kitsune
race.datura_origins.kitsune.description: A fox who lived a thousand years and earned nine tails as white as snow. A messenger of the shrines, she keeps a star pearl that brings her back from death, and her ghost flames burn and freeze whatever she hunts.
race.datura_origins.kitsune.advantage.0: Agile: 2 extra hearts, 1.5 more damage, runs 18% faster and jumps higher.
race.datura_origins.kitsune.advantage.1: Fox eyes: night vision, and luck is always on her side.
race.datura_origins.kitsune.advantage.3: Fox fire and spirit frost: her hits burn and freeze, and she is immune to freezing.
race.datura_origins.kitsune.advantage.4: Light paws: walks on powder snow without sinking.
race.datura_origins.kitsune.advantage.5: Foxes treat her as one of their own.
race.datura_origins.kitsune.disadvantage: Creature of the night: deals 1 less damage during the day.
race.datura_origins.kitsune.passive.0: Star Pearl: when she dies, she gets back up with 1 heart, pushing and hurting anyone nearby (once every 10 minutes).
race.datura_origins.kitsune.ability.name: Spirit Orb
race.datura_origins.kitsune.ability.desc: Throws a blue mana sphere where she aims. If it hits a creature, it explodes, deals 5 damage and freezes nearby enemies, then flies back to the Kitsune and explodes again when it arrives. If it hits nothing, it simply returns. Cooldown: 9 seconds.
race.datura_origins.kitsune_corrompida.d: A Kitsune who tasted the strength of others and could not stop. Her nine tails darkened to a blood red, and she chains her prey before finishing them.
race.datura_origins.kitsune_corrompida.a: More brutal: 2.5 extra hearts, 3 more damage and runs 10% faster.
Fox eyes: night vision, and luck is always on her side.
Fox fire and spirit frost: her hits burn and freeze, and she is immune to freezing.
Light paws: walks on powder snow without sinking.
Foxes treat her as one of their own.
race.datura_origins.kitsune_corrompida.d: Creature of the night: deals 1 less damage during the day.
race.datura_origins.kitsune_corrompida.p: Star Pearl: when she dies, she gets back up with 1 heart, pushing and hurting anyone nearby (once every 10 minutes).
race.datura_origins.kitsune_corrompida.a: Red chains burst from her and instantly bind the 3 closest creatures within 10 blocks (monsters, animals or other players), dealing 5 damage. Bound for 3 seconds, they cannot move; then they stay chained for 5 more seconds, pulled back if they go beyond 10 blocks and taking continuous damage. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
